proof: For each retained row i, let phi_i be its dihedral-orbit average of the even-parity character (-1)^|I intersect T|. Then ||phi_i||_infinity <= 1 and E_{w_R} phi_i is the corresponding principal-minor moment. With exact row scale s_i, define G(T)=sum_i z_i phi_i(T)/s_i. Its sup norm is at most M=sum_i |z_i|/s_i. The Arb-certified dual gives E_u G - E_{w_p} G > objective-slack for every mixture p on the exact 204-column pool. By the TV dual inequality, TV(w_p,u) > (objective-slack)/(2M).
scope: One selected parity sector and arbitrary probability mixtures over exactly the 204 certified physical columns. This is a balanced program-label mass / dephased label-register trace-distance statement, not a Choi trace-distance or channel diamond-distance lower bound.
